name: Argentina
blurb: South American country whose Patagonian Cueva de las Manos preserves ancient hand-stencil proto-writing.

name: Patagonia
blurb: Southern South American region containing Cueva de las Manos and its 9,000-year-old hand stencils.

name: Sinai
loc: Peninsula between Egypt and the Levant
blurb: Peninsula whose Serabit el-Khadim turquoise mines yielded early Proto-Sinaitic alphabetic inscriptions.

name: Phoenicia
blurb: Ancient Levantine coastal region whose 22-letter alphabet seeded the Greek, Latin, Arabic and Hebrew scripts.

name: Greece
blurb: Where the Phoenician abjad gained vowel letters and became the world's first true alphabet.

name: Kish tablet
blurb: Among the earliest proto-cuneiform pictographic tablets, a direct ancestor of cuneiform writing.
